resources.name: Molar heat capacities of cyanoadamantane (stable and metastable phases)

access.notes: Extracted from Table I of the published paper; provided as CSV in the task bundle.

resources.notes: The table contains temperature (K) and molar Cp (J/K/mol) for both the stable ordered/plastic phases and the metastable glassy/supercooled plastic phases.
